name: Anub'arak
title: Traitor King of Azjol-Nerub
description: A heavily armored nerubian lord who burrows under ground fronts, bursting upward to disrupt lines and absorb frontal punishment.

name: Arthas Minithil
title: Crown Prince of Lordaeron
description: A frontline paladin juggernaut wrapped in enchanted holy plate armor, converting taking damage into unbreakable protective barriers.

name: Glicerita Biskleta
title: The Unstoppable Wheel
description: Built with relentless kinetic force, Glicerita charges headfirst into enemy frontlines like a runaway engine. Utilizing his mountain bike he draws all enemy fire toward himself while continuously gaining momentum, turning every incoming blow into explosive forward energy.

name: Sheer O' Thavi
title: The Nut Cracker
description: A continental colossus able to use the earth and shape it into mud reshaping it into any structure limited only by his imagination.
